blocks.content: A computer system works through the interaction of several components. The major components of a computer system are Hardware, Software, Firmware, and Humanware. Each component performs a specific role in the functioning of a computer.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Hardware encompasses all physical, tangible devices and circuitry forming the computer system.
Software comprises the collection of programs, protocols, and routines that direct computer operations.
Firmware represents permanent software programmed directly into non-volatile memory like ROM.
Humanware (Liveware) covers the individuals who design, program, operate, and maintain computer systems.

blocks.content: Hardware refers to the physical components of a computer that can be seen and touched.

items: Input Devices – Keyboard, Mouse, Scanner, Microphone
Output Devices – Monitor, Printer, Speakers, Plotter
Processing Devices – CPU, Motherboard
Storage Devices – Hard Disk, SSD, Pen Drive, CD/DVD
Keyboard
Mouse
Monitor
Printer
Hard Disk
CPU
Hardware is the physical part of a computer system.
CPU is the main processing component.
Hardware requires software to function.

blocks.content: Software is a collection of programs and instructions that tell the computer how to perform tasks.

items: System Software – Operating systems like Windows and Linux.
Application Software – Programs like MS Word, Excel, and browsers.
Utility Software – Antivirus, backup tools, disk cleanup.
Windows OS
Linux
MS Word
MS Excel
Google Chrome
Software provides instructions to hardware.
Operating System is the most important system software.
Without software, hardware cannot perform tasks.

rows: Offers fixed operational control for specific hardware
Designs, operates, and utilizes the computing ecosystem

blocks.content: Firmware is specialized software embedded into hardware devices that provides low-level control.

items: Stored in ROM or Flash memory.
Provides instructions for hardware devices.
Usually permanent but can sometimes be updated.
BIOS
Router firmware
Printer firmware
Smartphone firmware
Firmware acts as a bridge between hardware and software.
BIOS is the most commonly asked firmware example.

blocks.content: Humanware refers to the people involved in designing, operating, and maintaining computer systems.

items: BIOS (Basic Input/Output System) is a high-frequency exam topic classified specifically as Firmware, not standard application software.
Distinguish between System Software (Operating Systems, Translators) and Application Software (MS Word, Browsers).
Humanware is also termed as Liveware in competitive exams and includes roles like System Analysts and Programmers.
End Users – People who use computers for daily activities.
Programmers – People who write computer programs.
System Analysts – Professionals who design computer systems.
Network Administrators – Manage computer networks.
Operates computer systems.
Develops software.
Maintains computer networks.
Humanware refers to the human component of a computer system.
It includes users, programmers, and administrators.
